START TRACKING THIS FOLDER WITH GIT
Tap a commit to view your project as it was at that point. This does not change your history — you can switch back to a branch anytime.
This opens commit %1$s. You will not be on a branch until you switch back to one — nothing about your history changes.
This only forgets the address named “%1$s” on this device. Nothing on GitHub is deleted. If other actions (like Push) rely on this name, set it up again before using them.
This restores every tracked file to its last commit, discarding all staged and unstaged edits at once. Files git doesn’t know about yet (untracked/new files) are left alone. This cannot be undone.
